svg.title: What three chatbot privacy settings do, and what they don’t
svg.desc: Training off: chats are not used to improve the model, but they are still stored and staff may still access them. Temporary chat: not in your history and not used for training, but a copy may be kept for up to 30 days in ChatGPT, or is kept for 72 hours in Gemini. Deleting a chat: it is removed from your account, but removal from the company’s systems can take up to 30 days and some copies are kept longer.
